title: Abacus and Scroll Machine
description: A girl with a long braid stands in a mystical room, holding an abacus while reaching toward a large mechanical device with gears that is unspooling a long scroll filled with equations. The walls and floor are covered in mathematical formulas, with an open book, candle, and scattered papers in the foreground and rows of small machines visible in the background.
